scripts.migrate:dev: cd ../../apps/site && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev --local
scripts.seed:dev: bun scripts/seed.ts && cd ../../apps/site && wrangler d1 execute DB --env dev --local --file ../../packages/db/seed/dev.sql && wrangler kv key put catalog:version seed-$(date +%s) --binding KV --env dev --local
